source: Stats SA Report 02-11-02, Labour Market Dynamics in South Africa 2022, Table 4.4 (domestic workers, 839 thousand); Stats SA Report 02-11-20, Monthly earnings in South Africa 2017-2022, Table 1.4 (median monthly earnings of domestic workers 2022, R2,350); copies in data/statssa_hhe_2022/
decided_by: Claude (beta v4 extra fixes thread; David 2026-10-26 08:15 UTC "fix those"; spec from S16 final dataset checks 08:29 UTC)
basis: ESTIMATE: Stats SA publishes no 2022 value added of private households (P0441 folds it into personal services; the latest supply-use table, 2020-21, groups households with informal and non-profit activity) and no mean earnings of domestic workers, so the value is 839 thousand workers x the median R2,350 a month x 12 = R23.66 bn, about 1.45 bn USD at 16.356 ZAR per USD (WDI PA.NUS.FCRF 2022). The median understates a mean if pay is right-skewed; the QLFS quarterly counts were 808, 858, 826 and 863 thousand. Paid domestic services are valued at the compensation paid (SNA 2008), so VA = output = this value.
